project.title: Proteins that directly interact with the full-length LINC01198, with EGFP as a control, in vemurafenib-resistant melanoma cells.
project.projectDescription: Using EGFP RNA as a control, the full-length LINC01198 pull-down was performed to identify proteins that directly interact with LINC01198 in vemurafenib-resistant melanoma cells.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: A 20 μg sample of immunoprecipitated protein mix was separated by sodium dodecyl sulfate-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis (SDS-PAGE) and stained with Coomassie brilliant blue R250 and then processed with Trypsin Profile IGD Kit.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Calibration was carried out using a standard peptide mixture. The mass spectra were subjected to sequence database search with Proteome Discoverer v2.1 software (Thermo Scientific).

references.referenceLine: Liu J, Liang X, Wang K, Zhang C, Li C, Zhao L, Kuang Y, Wang M, Liu J, Zhou L, Ma L. LINC01198 activates Hippo signaling to stimulate IL-1β autocrine for driving vemurafenib resistance by associating with TAOK1/2 in melanoma. Cell Death Discov. 2025 11(1):486
